svg.aria-label: Commit Breakout: a self-playing Breakout level where every brick is a day of commits from the last year (322 days, 3,654 commits, private repositories included). The busiest day triggers multiball, the start of the 12-day streak triggers fireball, and the score ends at 3,654.
svg.title: Commit Breakout: a self-playing Breakout level where every brick is a day of commits from the last year (322 days, 3,654 commits, private repositories included). The busiest day triggers multiball, the start of the 12-day streak triggers fireball, and the score ends at 3,654.
svg.text: # 1 brick = 1 day of commits, private repos included · the public graph (4423) would leave this level empty
★ busiest day → multiball · ϟ streak start → fireball · bright days take 2 hits · score = commits destroyed · loops every 27s
